objective: Verify an exact ConvTranspose2d K3/S2/P1/OP1 descriptor FIFO that atomically expands each source event and coalesces cross-event tails into up to eight transport lanes only across equal tag/time and non-stream-last boundaries. Per-lane event fences preserve source identities; tag/time mismatch, stream-last, and sticky-fault drain force a partial flush. This descriptor-only module does not implement the M218/C2 eight-weight-bank contract and does not claim polyphase, zero-skip, or C2-integration novelty.

exact_functional_contract.cross_event_packing: Only equal tag/time after a non-stream-last per-lane event boundary.

required_covers: 18-of-18 descriptor FIFO occupancy under output stall
illegal successor while accepted work is stalled
fault lockout followed by exact accepted-work drain

author_static_repairs.rtl_architecture_repair: The original per-event 8+1 emitter is replaced by an 18-entry atomic descriptor FIFO and boundary-aware equal-tag/time tail coalescer; every output lane carries an event-boundary marker. The eight lanes are descriptor transport lanes, not C2 weight banks.
author_static_repairs.sva_tail_cover_repair: The campaign covers a measured one-tap boundary flush, cross-event tail fill, stream-last flush, full FIFO, same-edge input/output, and sticky-fault drain independently of random inter-cycle spacing.
author_static_repairs.tb_reset_release_repair: rst_core is released on a negative edge to remove a positive-edge sampling race.
author_static_repairs.tb_final_ledger_repair: The final campaign now fail-closes on full8=3, tails1=3, phase counts 6/10/10/17, nonzero stalls and replacements, and exactly one measured protocol attack.

exact_vcs_runner_contract.runner_sha_binding: Caller pins M523_EXPECTED_RUNNER_SHA256; the future independent static-review JSON must authorize that exact observed SHA for one invocation.
exact_vcs_runner_contract.exact_pass_line_regex: ^PASS M523 events=6 bundles=8 taps=43 full8=4 tails1=1 stalls=[1-9][0-9]* replacements=[1-9][0-9]* boundaries=6 cross_event=2 tag_flush=1 time_flush=1 stream_flush=2 stream_iso=1 fifo_max=18 phases=6/10/10/17 protocol_attack=1$
exact_vcs_runner_contract.atomic_publish: sealed staging is verified, renamed to canonical, and verified again before success

vcs_generated_symlink_profile.requirements: Each link, raw target, resolved in-tree regular target, and resolved-target SHA is inventoried in VCS_SYMLINKS.json; SHA256SUMS covers every regular file other than its own two seals; post-move topology must exactly match the inventory.
